subject.title: refactor(ios): simplify node and Watch lifecycle ownership

question: Should the iOS owner accept this cross-lifecycle refactor after reviewing the new ownership boundaries and live Apple-runtime evidence?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and the movement of stateful approval, notification, and Watch behavior require an owner judgment beyond automated cleanup.

options.title: Review with runtime proof
options.body: Accept the refactor only after an iOS owner confirms the ownership boundaries and redacted simulator or device evidence exercises the changed flows.

options.title: Narrow the refactor
options.body: Ask for a smaller change if owner review finds the extracted helpers obscure or alter an established lifecycle boundary.

recommendation.title: Review with runtime proof
recommendation.body: Accept the refactor only after an iOS owner confirms the ownership boundaries and redacted simulator or device evidence exercises the changed flows.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history attributes the proposed iOS lifecycle ownership refactor to steipete, although current-main ownership provenance remains incomplete.
